name: mailchannels
description: MailChannels Email API is a transactional email API for any application: password resets, sign-in links, verification codes, receipts, invitations and notifications. Send over REST or SMTP with official JavaScript, Python and PHP SDKs, or keep Laravel Mail, Symfony Mailer or Nodemailer and switch the transport; tested recipes cover Next.js, Express, React Email, Django and Rails. Every API send reports delivery, bounce and complaint events through signed webhooks, with managed DKIM, suppressions and one-click unsubscribe. Optional sub-accounts give each customer or agent its own credentials and limits when they send through your product. Outbound only; the free developer plan delivers only to verified recipients until a payment method is added.
